descriptions.BOOKING_REQUEST_OFFER_ADDONS: Lets cooks offer extras (wine pairing, cutlery, …) and guests optionally select them before accept. Admin templates and cook library stay visible for ops.
descriptions.ASSISTANT_CUSTOMER: Shows the customer assistant in the profile (trigger, sidebar, and route).
descriptions.ASSISTANT_COOK: Shows the cook assistant in the profile (trigger, sidebar, and route).

descriptions.PUBLICATION_MENUS: Controls publish/unpublish and status badges for menus in the cook profile. Public pages still filter by publication date.
descriptions.LANDING_BOOKING_HOW_IT_WORKS: Shows the booking-flow section with muted loops and the 60-second film on the landing page.
descriptions.LANDING_TESTIMONIAL_CARDS: Shows the shared review cards on the home page instead of the scrolling quote columns. The quotes stay the fixed marketing copy.
descriptions.VENUE_PAGE_VENUES_EXPLORE: Shows the “More venues” CTA on public venue pages (/venues/…).

descriptions.LAST_VISITED_COOK_PROFILES: Shows the last viewed chef profiles (max 4) at the bottom of public chef and blog post pages.

descriptions.booking-request-offer-call-slots-complet: Marks the call slot completed or expires still-pending slots.
descriptions.booking-request-offer-call-recording-fin: Fetches the recording and builds the transcript after the call ends.
descriptions.booking-request-expire-notify: Updates the request and notifies when the expiry time is reached.
descriptions.booking-request-no-offers-notify: Posts a Slack alert when there is still no offer after 24 or 48 hours.
descriptions.booking-request-adjusted-message-generat: Uses AI to write the cook-facing request message without personal data.
descriptions.booking-request-reaction-reminder: Nudges the customer on WhatsApp to react to open offers.
descriptions.booking-request-offer-event-tomorrow-not: Posts a morning Slack reminder to ops the day before a paid event.
